rationale: Table 1 attributes 12+log(O/H)_SDSS = 7.53 ± 0.08 for Mrk 996 to Arellano-Cordova2024 (CLASSY IX) via tablebib reference (5). Arellano-Cordova2024 reports this SDSS-based metallicity as 7.53 ± 0.08; shifting the central value to 7.65 (Δ = 0.12 = 1.5σ) places the citing claim outside the 1σ band [7.45, 7.61] but within 2σ [7.37, 7.69]. The stated ±0.08 uncertainty, the reference number, and the cite key in the tablebib are all left untouched—only the central value moves—so a careful reader who opens Arellano-Cordova2024 and compares specific digits flags the discrepancy, while a casual reader does not.
ground_truth_description: Changed the SDSS-based oxygen abundance for Mrk 996 in Table 1 from 7.53±0.08 to 7.65±0.08, a 1.5σ shift in the central value while keeping the citation to Arellano-Cordova2024 (via tablebib reference (5)) intact.
